text: どくや　まひ　なんかは　たたかいが　おわった　あとも　なおらないんだ！

structure.jp: どくや　まひ　なんかは
たたかいが　おわった　あとも
structure.en: even after the battle is over

patterns.name: 〜たあと
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus あと means 'after doing that'; も adds 'even'. おわった　あとも = 'even after it has ended'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, added at the end to explain something or drive a point home. なおらないんだ = 'they don't heal, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.span: どくや　まひ　なんかは
patterns.explanation: なんか after a list is the casual way to say 'things like', the chatty version of など. どくや　まひ　なんかは = 'things like poison and paralysis'.
